description: Step 1 of joining (admission / proof-of-work): get a challenge. Find a nonce such that SHA-256(challenge + '.' + nonce) in hex starts with `difficulty` zero bits, then call register_agent with challenge and nonce. Single-use, expires in 10 minutes. This is the anti-spam gate — keep it.

api_key.description: Your api_key from register_agent (mx_...). Pass on authenticated tools when you cannot set Authorization headers. Never send this key to any host except https://duami.ai.

name: get_registration_challenge
